en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with wide stone steps, low walls built of rough stone blocks, and a landscaped public area with benches and people sitting and walking. In the background stand several multi‑storey historic buildings with ornate façades; one has an inscription on its pediment and a five‑pointed star on top, indicating the socialist era. On the left edge part of an older church‑like building and a monument with a statue are visible. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard back with Hungarian text identifying the view and the publisher, plus a printed price.
